title: Prove a receiver-only obstruction to a root-2 stage deletion (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped mathematical obstruction with an exact finite certificate; no new kappa. For one direct attempt to remove owned 772's frame-520 stage from DreamingOfClouds's PR6144 word, arbitrary receiver-only homogeneous linear compensation cannot preserve the next 145/161 consumer contract.

```text
separating input: x_32=1, x_5=-1, all other independent inputs zero
edited receiver and every available donor in the fixed window: 0
required receiver at the next consumer: -1/2
```

The edit moves 497's root read to 737 and removes its register-48 read. The exact missing form is V=x_48+x_32+x_98+x_85; at the consumer cut, only rows 497 and 161 change, by -V and V/2. The proof allows arbitrary constant coefficients, repeated reads and replacement of receiver scalar operations, while freezing the prefix, trajectories and nonreceiver events. A successful stage deletion must change another source, trajectory, earlier prefix or consumer contract.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. The predecessor word and open lead are DreamingOfClouds's; retain Ali Romman, Mason Hale, Pierre-Loic Doulcet and the full P104 lineage. Available-span separation is classical; Jonathan Capalbo's PR6069 and JoyboyBrian's PR6084 provide related uses. The new contribution is this attempted edit and its explicit two-coordinate certificate, not a new general separation method or an audit of a predecessor.

## Evidence

Before: the root-2 stage-removal lead has no completed legal schedule. After: this particular rerouting is proved impossible to repair only at receiver 161 in the specified window. The broader lead remains open.

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library:

- All 2,712 cuts and 241,377 coframed donor occurrences pass the separating-input check, including cuts without an existing receiver ADD.
- A separate sparse symbolic interpreter checks the proposed edit's differences over all 799 input coordinates at the consumer cut.
- Five false-claim controls reject a changed source anchor, wrong witness sign, two unavailable reads and a wrong root-read coefficient. They also run with assertions disabled.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass in 0.653 and 0.588 seconds locally; each registered command has a 120-second limit. These are timeout measurements, not speedup claims.
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The generated receipt binds the upstream word and verifier SHA256 and is compared byte for byte.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes all nine package files at `1743bbafb49ad2a351f6412825fb08d4a7c4f086`. The official committed export and input-coverage check pass. Normal and optimized direct checks pass from a read-only Git-free export; all ten exported files retain their exact hashes.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/p104-root2-receiver-obstruction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/p104-root2-receiver-obstruction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-root2-receiver-obstruction
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-root2-receiver-obstruction --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the displayed path. Expected direct status is `PASS_ROOT2_RECEIVER_OBSTRUCTION`. The predecessor word from `4f3b67e7c37ae270da9584033132866d0cf63e42` is retained byte for byte with its original Git blob, SHA256, author and path in `UPSTREAM.json`; cold replay needs no network or unmerged Git object. The scientific base is canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, refreshed before submission.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is one exact negative construction test and a scoped all-length compensation proof. It does not exclude repairing outside the window, changing sources or trajectories, or accepting and correcting a changed value at the consumer. Frame 737 is unattempted. The attempted edited word is incorrect and is not supplied as a valid multiplier or supplier.

No new paid invoice, native implementation, physical caller, full predecessor replay, selected cold replay, compiler/outer replay, rounded numerical analysis, Lean or Docker run is claimed. The five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. All additions are isolated in `research/p104-root2-receiver-obstruction/`.

## Open next questions

Can another source or consumer contract remove root 772's frame-520 stage? First change one source trajectory or the 145/161 cut, track both the separating input and the full missing form, and charge every additional move and target change. No favorable complete invoice or legal arbitrary-input construction is supplied here.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI.** For head `1743bbafb49ad2a351f6412825fb08d4a7c4f086`, [run 40727358672](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40727358672) failed `plan` in the shared onboarding helper tests. `replay (research/p104-root2-receiver-obstruction)` was skipped, so **the package replay did not run in CI**. Local passing checks above remain separate evidence.

The only two failed tests are:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record`: expects the exact text `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`; the document instead has `**0.003125804 = 781451/250000000**`.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: expects `` `make frontier6030-verify` `` in `docs/ci-verification.md`; that document still presents the PR5599 replay. The test and log identify this exact navigation path.

The run reports `Ran 678 tests` and `FAILED (failures=2, skipped=23)`. Both mismatches are already present on base/main [721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419), the PR6030 kappa admission pushed with `[skip ci]`. That commit changed the selected record without updating the documentation contracts to match. This contribution changes neither document. The same two failures are confirmed in [PR #6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027). Open [PR #6050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6050) targets the fix.

A maintainer re-run is required after main is fixed. No hosted package replay or CI certification is claimed. No documentation repair or new commit was pushed after this failure.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. Shared code, predecessor packages, frozen evidence and the selected frontier are unchanged.
